title: Shakespeare's First Folio
summary: Seven years after Shakespeare's death, his colleagues published 36 of his plays in one collected book.
why: Eighteen of its 36 plays were not known to have been printed before.

notes.problem: 'Saved about half his plays, which would otherwise have been lost' is not in the source; it says 18 plays were 'not known to have been previously printed'.

superlativeSource: commonly referred to by modern scholars as the '''First Folio'''
